Problem Statement:
Salesman A has to reach a destination B as soon as possible to deliver a product. The roads of the city are modelled as a matrix, with every cell in the matrix denoting the distance a road covers. Find out the shortest distance that the salesman can travel so as to reach the destination soon. 
Input Description:
Dimensions of the matrix followed by the elements of the matrix. Elements A and B represent positions of the salesman and the destination respectively. 
Output Description:
Length of the shortest path. 
Sample Input:
3 3
A 2 3
1 1 B
1 2 3 
Sample Output:
2 
Explanation:
The salesman travels along (1,0),(1,1) to reach B which is at (1,2)
